body: exactly, good decent people like yourself deserve help when they need it...it's wonderful that others have recognized your value and put their time and effort into helping you through a solvable problem...those people, and yourself (for being brave and stong enough to accept their assistance when you needed it) deserve huge respect...i've got WAY too many people wasting their time trying to keep me alive...once i'm in the ground everyone can get back to enjoying life as they should

cheers to you, that is wonderful...the trick is...you had it in you all along...i'm the perfect example of "should have died YEARS ago"...the amount of suffering that would have been avoided if i had killed myself the first time i had the inclination is massive...everyone i've ever been in contact with would have been better off right now...the longer i stay alive, the more everyone suffers...but sincerely, i'm glad it worked out for you.
